name: SemEval-2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials
description: This benchmark focuses on safe biomedical natural language inference for clinical trials, featuring the NLI4CT-P dataset designed to challenge LLMs with interventional and causal reasoning tasks. It aims to improve robustness and applicability of NLI models in healthcare.
reputation: Hosted a competition with 106 participants and over 1200 submissions, indicating strong community engagement.
notes: Dataset and leaderboard are publicly available; focuses on robustness against shortcut learning and adversarial inputs.
